verdict.rationale: The only status-related evidence is the employer-registration page, which says you can "check when to expect your letter from HMRC about your registration" (hmrc-docs-15). That gives a generic timing expectation on a public page, not a lookup of your own filing, application or case. Managing Corporation Tax online happens inside a signed-in business tax account (hmrc-docs-1), not on public pages. Missing for 10: a public-page lookup of a specific filing, application or case status; status coverage beyond employer registration (e.g. VAT registration, Corporation Tax filings, enquiries); documentation of what the timing check shows; independent or hands-on corroboration.
